english.title: Aid and abet, remain on / enter premises in contravention of a closure order

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: anti social behaviour crime and policing act 2014

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) aided, abetted, counselled or procured **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to, without reasonable excuse,

(A)_[remain on]_
(B)_[enter]_

premises, namely **(..SPECIFY PREMISES..), in contravention of a closure order issued by **(..SPECIFY COURT..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE OF ISSUE..) under section 80 of the Anti-social Behaviour, Crime and Policing Act 2014
english.legislation: Contrary to section 86(2) and (5) of the Anti-social Behaviour, Crime and Policing Act 2014 and section 44 of the Magistrates Court Act 1980.
english.pointstoprove:

other.penalty:
Summary: 6 months imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time Limit for Prosecutions:
Six months.Note
In relation to an offence committed before the commencement of section 281(5) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003, the reference to 51 weeks is to be read as a reference to 6 months.
